This confirms all two-arg calls pass literal `true` — no other variable second-args exist. That matches the 17 count (excluding the function definition itself in `src\lib\format.js`).

**17 call sites** across the repo still pass the legacy second argument to `formatAmount`. Breakdown by file:

- `src\reports\quarterly.js` — **5** (most)
- `src\admin\exports.js` — 3
- `src\billing\invoice.js` — 3
- `src\reports\monthly.js` — 2
- `src\checkout\cart.js` — 2
- `src\checkout\receipt.js` — 1
- `src\billing\statement.js` — 1

`src\reports\quarterly.js` has the most, with 5 call sites (`bundle`, `holdback`, `subtotal`, `surcharge`, `gross`) still passing `true`.
